description: List mailbox files with bounded pagination (100 by default, maximum 100). Use pagination.next_offset for subsequent pages. query searches file names/paths; folder lists immediate files. Use mailbox_email_list for received emails and durable arrival cursors.

account_id.description: Optional account id from revdoku_status.accounts for this call only. Omit for the credential's default account. Client accounts require explicit Agency authorization; never infer an account from a mailbox id.

folder.description: Optional folder path to list only that folder's immediate files, name-ordered. Use "" or "/" for the mailbox root.

limit.description: Maximum files to return, up to 100; defaults to 100.

offset.description: Optional zero-based offset. Use pagination.next_offset for the next page.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive contains-search over file names and paths.

reason.description: Optional reason for this action. AI agents should include a short purpose for intentional reads and changes when known. Do not invent a reason or include secrets, file contents, or transcripts.

name: mailbox_file_list

read.description: Whether an intentional read of this revision has been recorded. Not proof of processing or OTP use.

title: Mailbox File List
